title: Russia Says Open to 'New Ideas' on Ukraine War, But Only If They Match Putin's Terms
detail: August 21, 2026 — Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Sergey Ryabkov said Moscow is willing to consider new proposals to end the war in Ukraine, but only if they align with President Putin's objectives and reflect 'current military realities' — i.e., Ukraine's cession of the Donbas, demilitarization, and abandonment of NATO membership aspirations remain Russia's stated preconditions. Ryabkov said Russia wants to build on continued US diplomatic involvement, crediting the Trump administration with showing 'an understanding of Russia's position.' The comments came as Kyiv said it was awaiting a renewed Witkoff-Kushner shuttle visit; the Kremlin said it had no confirmed information on a new visit from the two US envoys, while President Zelensky said Ukraine's diplomatic team was 'preparing decisions' ahead of any next round.
